pack_metadata.title: Discover and claim a deceased person's Central and regulated financial assets
pack_metadata.user_outcome: Build an evidence-backed inventory of possible assets, route each asset to the correct institution, and preserve separate proof of discovery, submission, and successful transmission or payment.
pack_metadata.central_scope: India-wide Central-government and regulated-sector routes for bank deposits, listed securities and demat holdings, mutual funds, life insurance, EPF/EPS/EDLI, NPS, IEPF-held shares or amounts, and Central small-savings or postal accounts. A death certificate is assumed to exist.
explicit_exclusions: A national determination of inheritance, beneficial ownership, or the effect of nomination under personal law
State-specific legal-heir certificates, stamp duty, registration, notarisation practice, probate, succession-certificate, or letters-of-administration procedure
Real property, state-cooperative institutions, unregulated investments, private debts, tax filing, and estate administration outside the named asset classes
Any assurance of entitlement, interest, limitation, fee, waiver, threshold, or completion time not supported by a current cited primary source

qualifying_questions.question: Do you have a verifiable death certificate, and does each institution's record match the deceased person's name and date of birth?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Every covered claim route requires death evidence; identity mismatches can stop discovery or transmission.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: If no verifiable death proof exists, stop all claim-submission tasks; this pack assumes it exists but does not assume record matching.

qualifying_questions.question: For each asset, are you a surviving joint holder, registered nominee, executor or administrator, or a legal heir without a recorded nomination?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The institution's record and claimant capacity determine the route and documents; one capacity cannot be reused across assets without confirmation.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Unknown or unverified capacity blocks final entitlement and may require institution, state-authority, or court evidence.

qualifying_questions.question: Is there a will, a competing claimant, a court restraint, or a dispute about the asset?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The simplified SEBI transmission framework excludes disputed or competing claims, and banks must respect court restraints; testate and intestate routes are case dependent.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: A competing claim, restraint, or unresolved will-related authority stops automated happy-path routing and requires institution-specific and possibly judicial handling.

qualifying_questions.question: Which asset clues exist: bank name/account, PAN or identity number, demat/DP details, folio, policy, UAN/PF account, PRAN/employer, company/folio, or post-office passbook/certificate?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: There is no verified single deceased-asset registry in this research; each asset class has different discovery inputs.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: No clue does not prove no asset exists; it leaves unsupported asset classes Action Required.

qualifying_questions.question: Is the bank deposit active, known to the bank, or returned by UDGAM as an unclaimed deposit?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: UDGAM is a discovery and bank-link service, not a claim portal; all claims go to the bank.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: A UDGAM match enables a bank claim but does not establish claimant entitlement or payment.

qualifying_questions.question: Are the securities in demat, physical certificates or statement-of-account form, or already transferred to IEPF?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The destination is respectively the DP, issuer/RTA/AMC, or the company/RTA plus MCA-IEPF route.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Unknown mode blocks submission until the DP, issuer/RTA, AMC/RTA, or company record is identified.

qualifying_questions.question: What is the value per beneficial-owner account or per issuer/AMC record on the institution's valuation date?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The 2026 SEBI transmission circular applies different QTP, simplified, and above-threshold evidence routes.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Do not select a SEBI transmission document band until the regulated entity establishes the applicable record and value.

qualifying_questions.question: Do you know the insurer, policy number, employer/group-policy link, or only an unclaimed-amount lead?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The Bima Bharosa page is an insurer directory; the death claim is submitted to the insurer or servicing branch.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: No insurer or policy lead leaves discovery incomplete; it does not establish that no cover existed.

qualifying_questions.question: What are the UAN/PF account and employer, and did death occur while in service; was the establishment exempted; what family, age, service, and nomination facts apply?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: PF, family pension and EDLI are separate claims with different claimant and event conditions.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Do not infer EPS or EDLI eligibility from a PF balance; unverified service, family, age, or exempted-establishment facts remain Action Required.

qualifying_questions.question: What are the PRAN, sector (government or non-government), CRA, associated nodal office/POP, nomination record, and date/circumstances of death?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Government and non-government death exits differ, and a live official FAQ conflicts with the current consolidated regulation on a government-sector threshold.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Unknown sector or nomination blocks entitlement routing; government-sector amount options require current CRA/nodal confirmation because of the recorded conflict.

qualifying_questions.question: Which company, folio/demat account, shares/dividends and original holder are involved, and has the company/RTA accepted the transmission evidence?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: IEPF-5 needs company-level details and company/bank verification; the SEBI transmission framework also applies to securities transferred to IEPF.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Unknown company/folio or unresolved transmission evidence blocks a reliable IEPF-5 claim.

qualifying_questions.question: Which scheme and account office apply, is there a nomination or surviving holder, what is the eligible balance, and have six months elapsed where no legal evidence is produced?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Central small-savings succession is scheme and fact dependent; the ₹5 lakh rule and available legal-evidence routes cannot be generalized without confirmation.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Do not select Forms 11/13/14/15 or a court/state document route until the account office confirms scheme, nomination, amount, and current rule set.

tasks.title: Build a deceased-asset lead inventory
tasks.user_goal: Record every known clue and preserve where it came from before making claims.
tasks.trigger: Death certificate exists and the family is ready to inspect records.
steps: List each possible asset separately with institution, identifiers, last statement/message, employer and source of clue.
Mark discovery status as unknown, searched, matched or ruled out only by the relevant institution.
Do not record a discovery match as ownership or settlement.
tasks.tracking: Maintain an asset-by-asset ledger with dates, references, pending documents and next institution.
tasks.rejection_handling: A missing identifier is a discovery gap, not a rejection and not proof of absence.
tasks.escalation: Use the asset-specific discovery or grievance task after identifying the regulated institution.

state_local_dependency.description: No state document is needed merely to create a private inventory.

tasks.fail_closed_note: This task produces discovery leads only; it cannot establish entitlement or completion.

tasks.title: Classify claimant capacity and succession gate per asset
tasks.user_goal: Know whether the institution records a survivor, nominee, executor/administrator or legal-heir route.
tasks.trigger: At least one asset or institution lead exists.
steps: Ask the institution what its record shows for that asset.
Separate survivor/joint-holder, nominee, executor/administrator and legal-heir routes.
If there is a dispute, competing claim or restraint, stop the simplified path and obtain institution-specific legal direction.
tasks.tracking: Record the institution and date that confirmed the claimant category and any missing evidence.
tasks.rejection_handling: Request written reasons for extra documents; do not manufacture a national succession checklist.
tasks.escalation: Case-specific state or judicial procedure may be necessary; the appropriate forum and document must be identified by the institution and competent authority.

state_local_dependency.description: Legal-heir certificates, notarisation, stamp duty, probate, succession certificates and letters of administration are conditional on facts, state practice and court jurisdiction.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Nomination or survivor status is not presented as a universal declaration of beneficial ownership.

tasks.title: Search RBI UDGAM for unclaimed bank deposits
tasks.user_goal: Find a possible unclaimed-deposit record and the responsible bank.
tasks.trigger: A bank is suspected or the bank is unknown and the deceased may have an unclaimed deposit.
steps: Register on UDGAM with the portal-required mobile details.
Search using account-holder name, selected bank and an available identity/date/address field.
Save the result and UDRN where provided, then follow the bank's claim-process link.
tasks.tracking: Retain search date, selected banks, result and UDRN; repeat only when a new bank or identifier becomes available.
tasks.rejection_handling: A no-match result is not proof that no deposit exists because the portal is limited to participating banks and deposits transferred to the DEA Fund.
tasks.escalation: Contact the identified bank for the claim; RBI/UDGAM does not settle it.

state_local_dependency.description: Discovery does not itself require succession evidence.

tasks.fail_closed_note: UDGAM is discovery evidence only; do not mark the bank asset paid or transmitted.

tasks.title: Submit the deceased-depositor claim to the bank
tasks.user_goal: Obtain a bank acknowledgement and, if approved, payment or transmission.
tasks.trigger: The bank/account or UDGAM match is known.

timelines.label: RBI benchmark for survivor/nominee claims
timelines.value: 15 days from receipt of claim, subject to proof of death and suitable identification
timelines.applicability: Accounts with survivor/nominee covered by the cited RBI customer-service instruction; verify bank receipt and completeness.

steps: Use the bank's deceased-claim channel or branch and identify the account/UDRN.
Ask the bank to confirm whether the record is joint-survivor, nominee, or no-nomination.
Submit only route-specific death, identity and account evidence; obtain a case/receipt reference.
Retain the bank's payment, closure/transmission advice or reasoned rejection separately from the receipt.
tasks.tracking: Use the bank's case ID/branch receipt; the SBI current policy provides one regulated-actor example of CRM case tracking.
tasks.rejection_handling: For nominee/survivor cases, challenge an unsupported demand for succession/probate/letters of administration or indemnity; for no-nomination cases, ask for the bank's board-approved threshold and written document basis.
tasks.escalation: Complain to the bank first, then use RBI CMS under the applicable Ombudsman conditions.

state_local_dependency.description: No-nomination, disputed, executor or legal-heir claims may require state/court succession evidence; requirements are bank- and case-specific.

tasks.fail_closed_note: The 15-day measure is not applied to disputed or incomplete cases, and SBI's workflow is not generalized to every bank.

tasks.title: Escalate an unresolved bank deceased claim
tasks.user_goal: Obtain a trackable independent RBI grievance review after first complaining to the bank.
tasks.trigger: The bank rejects the claim, gives an unsatisfactory reply, or does not reply within the applicable period.

fees_duties.label: RBI Ombudsman complaint fee
fees_duties.applicability: Complaints under the cited RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme FAQ.

timelines.label: Prior bank complaint wait
timelines.value: 30 days if no bank reply, unless a shorter regulatory reply period applies
timelines.applicability: RBI Ombudsman maintainability condition; an unsatisfactory reply can be escalated earlier.

steps: Preserve the complaint made to the bank and its reply or non-response date.
Submit on RBI CMS with documents and relief sought.
Track the complaint number and respond to RBI information requests.
tasks.tracking: RBI CMS complaint number.
tasks.rejection_handling: Use the CMS status and maintainability reason; correct missing facts without changing the underlying claim.
tasks.escalation: Follow the appeal/review route stated in the CMS order, if available and applicable.

state_local_dependency.description: The grievance route does not decide estate title or replace a court order.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A grievance reference is not settlement proof.

tasks.title: Identify the securities account, DP, issuer or RTA
tasks.user_goal: Find the regulated entity that can receive a transmission request.
tasks.trigger: A broker, demat, certificate, issuer, dividend or folio clue exists.
steps: Inspect statements, emails, dividend records and certificates for DP ID/client ID, issuer, folio and RTA.
Confirm holding mode and value with the relevant DP, issuer or RTA.
Route demat and physical holdings to separate transmission tasks.
tasks.tracking: Keep the DP/issuer/RTA response and the account/folio identifier.
tasks.rejection_handling: A single institution's no-record response does not rule out other DPs, issuers or folios.
tasks.escalation: After identifying an entity, use its grievance route and then SCORES if unresolved.

state_local_dependency.description: Discovery alone does not require a state succession document.

tasks.fail_closed_note: No verified Central cross-DP/cross-issuer deceased-claimant search was found.

tasks.title: Transmit securities from a deceased demat account
tasks.user_goal: Complete DP transmission into an eligible claimant or survivor account.
tasks.trigger: The demat account and DP are known.

fees_duties.label: Notarisation or state stamp duty
fees_duties.applicability: Only where the selected no-nomination route requires it; amount and process are state/case dependent.

timelines.label: Transmission processing
timelines.value: 21 calendar days after receipt of all required documents
timelines.applicability: Complete claims under the SEBI 2026 circular; excludes time before document completeness and disputed claims.

steps: Obtain DP confirmation of nomination/joint status and BO value.
Use survivor/nominee or the correct QTP, simplified or above-threshold no-nomination band.
Obtain acknowledgement listing missing documents, then complete the submission.
Retain the demat credit/CAS entry or reasoned rejection.
tasks.tracking: Use the DP's acknowledgement or optional online tracking reference.
tasks.rejection_handling: The DP must communicate delay/rejection reasons in writing; additional documents beyond the circular require written reasons.
tasks.escalation: Complain to the DP/depository first, then SCORES.

state_local_dependency.description: No-nomination routes may use notarised indemnity/NOC/family settlement, state legal-heir evidence or court documents according to the circular and facts.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Value band, relationship, nomination and absence of dispute must be verified by the DP before selecting documents.

tasks.title: Transmit physical listed securities through issuer or RTA
tasks.user_goal: Complete transmission and direct demat credit for physical listed securities.
tasks.trigger: The issuer/folio and physical certificates are known.

fees_duties.label: Notarisation or state stamp duty
fees_duties.applicability: Only for the selected no-nomination route; verify locally.

timelines.label: Transmission processing
timelines.value: 21 calendar days after receipt of all required documents
timelines.applicability: Complete claims under the SEBI 2026 circular.

steps: Confirm folio value and nomination/joint-holder status with issuer/RTA.
Submit the Transmission Request Form, latest claimant CML, death evidence and physical certificate plus route-specific documents.
Obtain completeness acknowledgement and retain direct demat credit or reasoned rejection.
tasks.tracking: Issuer/RTA acknowledgement and optional online reference.
tasks.rejection_handling: Require written missing-document or rejection reasons and cure only supported deficiencies.
tasks.escalation: Complain to issuer/RTA first, then SCORES.

state_local_dependency.description: No-nomination evidence may be state/judicial dependent; disputed claims are outside the simplified framework.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Do not treat a physical certificate or folio match as proof of claimant title.

tasks.title: Search MITRA for inactive or unclaimed mutual-fund folios
tasks.user_goal: Find a possible mutual-fund folio held in the deceased person's name.
tasks.trigger: A mutual-fund holding may exist or a folio is unknown/inactive.
steps: Access MITRA through the link hosted by MFCentral, an AMC, AMFI, QRTA or SEBI.
Search with the service's claimant/investor inputs.
Save match details and identify the AMC/RTA for transmission.
tasks.tracking: Retain the search/match reference and AMC/folio lead.
tasks.rejection_handling: No match does not exclude active folios or records outside MITRA's inactive/unclaimed definition.
tasks.escalation: Contact the relevant AMC/RTA; MITRA does not transmit units.

state_local_dependency.description: Discovery does not itself need succession evidence.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A MITRA result is discovery proof, not claimant entitlement or unit credit.

tasks.title: Transmit mutual-fund units through AMC or RTA
tasks.user_goal: Complete folio transmission to the eligible claimant.
tasks.trigger: The AMC and folio are known directly or through MITRA.

fees_duties.label: Notarisation or state stamp duty
fees_duties.applicability: Only for the selected no-nomination route.

timelines.label: Transmission processing
timelines.value: 21 calendar days after receipt of all required documents
timelines.applicability: Complete AMC-unit claims under the SEBI 2026 circular.

steps: Confirm AMC folio value, holder mode and nomination.
Use the current AMFI/AMC/RTA transmission form matching survivor/nominee or no-nomination value band.
Obtain completeness acknowledgement and retain the updated statement/CAS or reasoned rejection.
tasks.tracking: AMC/RTA acknowledgement or online tracking reference.
tasks.rejection_handling: Require written reasons and cure only source-supported deficiencies.
tasks.escalation: Complain to AMC/RTA first, then SCORES.

state_local_dependency.description: No-nomination evidence may require notarisation, state stamp duty, state legal-heir evidence or court documents.

tasks.fail_closed_note: MITRA discovery does not select the transmission route; the AMC record and current value do.

tasks.title: Escalate a securities or mutual-fund service grievance
tasks.user_goal: Track an unresolved transmission grievance on SCORES after first approaching the entity.
tasks.trigger: A DP/depository, issuer/RTA or AMC/RTA has not resolved the transmission grievance.
steps: First complain to the regulated entity.
Register on SCORES and submit the grievance with entity response/acknowledgement.
Track status and use the two review levels if applicable.
tasks.tracking: SCORES complaint number and dashboard.
tasks.rejection_handling: Correct entity/category or missing material as stated; SCORES is not a substitute for proving succession.
tasks.escalation: Use the SCORES review route; judicial/legal issues remain outside the service grievance.

state_local_dependency.description: SCORES does not determine contested inheritance.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A SCORES reference is a grievance proof, not transmission proof.

tasks.title: Identify insurer and possible policy or unclaimed amount
tasks.user_goal: Find the insurer that can confirm and process a death claim.
tasks.trigger: A policy, insurer, premium, employer group-cover or unclaimed-amount clue exists.
steps: Check policy papers, bank debits, employer records and messages.
Use IRDAI's Bima Bharosa unclaimed-amount page to reach insurer-specific searches where relevant.
Contact the insurer/servicing branch to confirm the policy and claimant route.
tasks.tracking: Retain insurer search results and the insurer's policy/service reference.
tasks.rejection_handling: No result in one insurer's unclaimed search is not proof that no policy exists.
tasks.escalation: Use the insurer grievance route, then Bima Bharosa if unresolved.

state_local_dependency.description: Discovery itself does not establish legal-heir status.

tasks.fail_closed_note: No verified single cross-insurer death-policy search was found; the cited page is a directory of insurer routes.

tasks.title: Submit the death claim to the insurer
tasks.user_goal: Obtain claim acknowledgement and insurer settlement or reasoned decision.
tasks.trigger: The insurer and policy/service record are known.
steps: Notify the insurer or servicing branch with policy identity and death details.
Obtain the insurer's product- and claimant-specific death-claim forms and document list.
Submit and retain acknowledgement, requests for information, and settlement credit or reasoned decision.
tasks.tracking: Use the insurer's claim number; LIC's cited route is an example, not a universal form list.
tasks.rejection_handling: Ask the insurer to identify the policy term or rule supporting missing documents or rejection.
tasks.escalation: Complain to insurer first; then Bima Bharosa and, if eligible, Insurance Ombudsman.

state_local_dependency.description: Legal-heir/executor disputes or absence of nomination may require case-specific succession evidence.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Policy benefit, nominee effect, limitation, interest and universal documents are not inferred from the LIC example.

tasks.title: Escalate an unresolved insurance grievance
tasks.user_goal: Register and track an insurance claim-service grievance with IRDAI after the insurer.
tasks.trigger: The insurer does not resolve the grievance within the cited period or gives an unsatisfactory response.

timelines.label: Insurer grievance response
timelines.applicability: The Bima Bharosa FAQ route; verify the grievance was first lodged with the insurer.

steps: Complain to the insurer and retain its grievance reference.
After the cited trigger, register on Bima Bharosa with policy and grievance details.
Track the IRDAI token and use an eligible Insurance Ombudsman route if necessary.
tasks.tracking: Bima Bharosa token/status.
tasks.rejection_handling: Correct missing policy or prior-insurer complaint data; the portal does not create policy entitlement.
tasks.escalation: Insurance Ombudsman eligibility and deadlines must be checked live for the specific complaint.

state_local_dependency.description: The grievance channel cannot decide contested inheritance.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Do not infer Ombudsman eligibility, compensation, or time limits not verified in this pack.

tasks.title: Classify EPF, EPS and EDLI death claims
tasks.user_goal: Identify the member record and keep PF, pension and death-in-service insurance routes separate.
tasks.trigger: A UAN/PF/employer clue exists.
steps: Identify UAN/PF account, employer, establishment status and service record.
Confirm death-in-service, family/nomination, age and service facts.
Route PF to Form 20, pension to Form 10D where applicable, and EDLI to Form 5IF only for the covered death event.
tasks.tracking: Use EPFO claim-status tools after submission; preserve employer/office details.
tasks.rejection_handling: A failed pension or EDLI condition does not decide the PF claim.
tasks.escalation: Use EPFiGMS with the relevant claim/office reference.

state_local_dependency.description: Legal-heir or guardian evidence may be needed where nomination/family rules require it; no national generic certificate is assumed.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Do not infer EPS/EDLI entitlement from employment or a PF balance alone.

tasks.title: Claim EPF balance after member death
tasks.user_goal: Submit Form 20 through the applicable EPFO/employer route and obtain payment or a reasoned decision.
tasks.trigger: PF member record and claimant category are confirmed.
steps: Complete Form 20 and the supporting death, bank and claimant evidence for the applicable route.
Submit through employer/EPFO or the portal path available for the recorded nominee.
Save claim reference and track payment or rejection.
tasks.tracking: EPFO claim status using office and PF account/claim identifiers.
tasks.rejection_handling: Cure only deficiencies stated by EPFO; if employer is unavailable use only the alternative attestation route stated in the current applicable instructions.
tasks.escalation: Register EPFiGMS grievance with claim reference.

state_local_dependency.description: Legal-heir/guardian evidence may be conditional on claimant status.

tasks.fail_closed_note: The cited Form 20 instructions have medium freshness; confirm the live form and submission mode with EPFO.

tasks.title: Claim eligible EPS family pension
tasks.user_goal: Submit the pension claim separately from PF.
tasks.trigger: EPFO confirms an applicable pension claimant category and service facts.
steps: Use Form 10D only after confirming family/nominee/dependent-parent and member-service conditions.
Submit route-specific evidence.
Retain PPO/pension confirmation or reasoned rejection.
tasks.tracking: EPFO claim-status reference and PPO if issued.
tasks.rejection_handling: Request the precise family, age, service or nomination condition relied upon.
tasks.escalation: Register EPFiGMS grievance.

state_local_dependency.description: Guardian or relationship evidence may be case dependent.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Pension entitlement and duration are not calculated in this pack.

tasks.title: Claim eligible EDLI benefit
tasks.user_goal: Submit Form 5IF separately where death occurred in covered service.
tasks.trigger: Death occurred while in service and EPFO/establishment confirms the EDLI route.
steps: Confirm death-in-service and unexempted/exempted establishment handling.
Complete Form 5IF with supported claimant and employer evidence.
Retain payment advice or reasoned rejection.
tasks.tracking: EPFO claim-status reference.
tasks.rejection_handling: Ask whether event, establishment status, membership or claimant category caused rejection.
tasks.escalation: Register EPFiGMS grievance.

state_local_dependency.description: Claimant/guardian evidence can be conditional.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Do not quote a benefit amount or assume every member death is EDLI-covered.

tasks.title: Escalate an EPFO death-claim grievance
tasks.user_goal: Register and track a delayed or unresolved EPFO claim.
tasks.trigger: An EPFO claim is pending, rejected or unresolved.

timelines.label: Further EPFO contact threshold
timelines.value: More than 15 days pending on EPFiGMS or unsatisfactory redressal
timelines.applicability: EPFO contact-page instruction for writing to the cited customer-service escalation address with grievance reference.

steps: Register on EPFiGMS with UAN/PF/claim reference and documents.
Track the registration number.
If pending beyond the cited threshold or unsatisfactory, contact EPFO's stated escalation address with the reference.
tasks.tracking: EPFiGMS registration number.
tasks.rejection_handling: Correct office/member/claim identifiers without combining separate PF, EPS and EDLI disputes.
tasks.escalation: Use the EPFO contact-page escalation; CPGRAMS may be a later Central grievance route but no precedence is inferred here.

state_local_dependency.description: Grievance processing does not determine contested succession.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A grievance response is not payment/PPO evidence.

tasks.title: Classify NPS death exit by sector and current rule
tasks.user_goal: Identify the correct CRA/nodal route and avoid applying stale government-sector thresholds.
tasks.trigger: A PRAN, NPS contribution or employer/nodal clue exists.
steps: Confirm PRAN, government/non-government sector, CRA, nodal office/POP and nomination.
For non-government death exit, use the current regulation's entire-wealth route subject to claimant proof.
For government-sector amount options, flag the ₹8 lakh regulation versus ₹5 lakh FAQ conflict and obtain written/current CRA or nodal confirmation.
tasks.tracking: Record the nodal/POP/CRA response and applicable regulation date.
tasks.rejection_handling: Do not use the conflicting FAQ threshold as an automatic rejection or entitlement rule.
tasks.escalation: Use the nodal/CRA grievance route and Pension Sahayak.

state_local_dependency.description: Without nomination, the non-government route expressly points to a state competent-authority legal-heir certificate or court succession certificate.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Government-sector payout choices remain Action Required until the official conflict is resolved for the case.

tasks.title: Submit the NPS death-withdrawal claim
tasks.user_goal: Obtain CRA acknowledgement and permitted lump-sum, periodic, or annuity outcome.
tasks.trigger: Sector, PRAN, nodal/POP/CRA and claimant route are confirmed.
steps: Use the claimant death-withdrawal form for the responsible CRA.
Submit to the associated nodal office/POP so it initiates and authorises the online claim.
Retain CRA acknowledgement, bank credit and any annuity/periodic-withdrawal contract separately.
tasks.tracking: CRA/nodal acknowledgement and PRAN-linked status.
tasks.rejection_handling: Ask for sector, nomination, legal-heir, bank, KYC or form deficiency in writing.
tasks.escalation: Use nodal/CRA grievance, then Pension Sahayak.

state_local_dependency.description: No-nomination non-government claims may need the regulation-specified state legal-heir certificate or court succession certificate.

tasks.fail_closed_note: This task is Verified only after case classification; the conflicting government-sector threshold is excluded from automated happy path.

tasks.title: Escalate an NPS death-claim grievance
tasks.user_goal: Obtain a trackable PFRDA-system grievance reference.
tasks.trigger: The nodal office/POP/CRA does not resolve the claim issue.
steps: Preserve the intermediary complaint and claim reference.
Register through Pension Sahayak with PRAN and supporting records.
Track the grievance reference and response.
tasks.tracking: Pension Sahayak grievance number.
tasks.rejection_handling: Keep the underlying entitlement conflict separate from service-delay remediation.
tasks.escalation: Use the portal's next review path if stated for the case.

state_local_dependency.description: The grievance system does not issue succession evidence.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A grievance closure does not itself prove payment or annuity purchase.

tasks.title: Identify IEPF-held shares or amounts and company record
tasks.user_goal: Establish the company, original holder, folio/demat and amount/share details needed for IEPF-5.
tasks.trigger: A company dividend/share/folio or IEPF clue exists.
steps: Use company/RTA records and IEPF disclosures to identify original holder, folio/demat, shares and amounts.
Contact the company's IEPF nodal officer/RTA to confirm the record and transmission evidence.
Do not submit IEPF-5 on an assumed company/folio.
tasks.tracking: Company/RTA correspondence and confirmed investor-wise record.
tasks.rejection_handling: A no-record response from one company does not rule out other companies or folios.
tasks.escalation: Use company/MCA service grievance routes once a specific filing or record exists.

state_local_dependency.description: Discovery alone does not establish succession.

tasks.fail_closed_note: No live, primary, reliably navigable cross-company deceased-claim discovery portal was verified in this research.

tasks.title: Complete transmission evidence and file IEPF-5
tasks.user_goal: Obtain SRN, company verification, and eventual shares/dividend refund.
tasks.trigger: Company/folio/amount is confirmed and the claimant can satisfy the applicable transmission route.

timelines.label: Company/bank online verification report
timelines.value: 30 days of receipt of the claim
timelines.applicability: IEPF e-verification instruction-kit process after the claim reaches the verifying company/bank.

steps: Confirm with company/RTA which SEBI transmission band/evidence applies.
Log in to MCA and file IEPF-5 under IEPF services.
Save SRN, acknowledgement and generated indemnity, then follow the kit's company/bank document and postal-receipt steps.
Track company online verification and retain the final demat/bank credit or rejection.
tasks.tracking: MCA SRN plus company nodal-officer verification status.
tasks.rejection_handling: Resolve company/RTA transmission deficiencies or MCA resubmission reasons; obtain written reasons for extra SEBI transmission documents.
tasks.escalation: Company/RTA grievance may use SCORES for the securities-service component; MCA/IEPF service grievance uses the stated Central portal route.

state_local_dependency.description: The IEPF-5 kit has conditional succession/probate/will/NOC fields, and the SEBI 2026 value-band framework may require state/judicial evidence.

tasks.fail_closed_note: SRN and company verification are intermediate proofs; only demat/bank credit proves successful refund.

tasks.title: Classify Central small-savings or postal death claim
tasks.user_goal: Identify the scheme, account office, holder/nominee status, eligible balance and current rule.
tasks.trigger: A post-office or Central small-savings passbook/certificate/account lead exists.

timelines.label: No-nomination simplified-route waiting condition
timelines.value: Legal evidence not produced within six months of death
timelines.applicability: General Rule 15 route for eligible balance not exceeding ₹5 lakh; verify current scheme/account-office application.

steps: Identify scheme, account office, holder mode, nomination and eligible balance.
Ask the account office to confirm the current scheme rule and forms.
Flag the source conflict about above-₹5-lakh legal evidence and do not auto-select a document.
tasks.tracking: Written/account-office confirmation of scheme, route and required forms.
tasks.rejection_handling: Ask the account office to cite the current rule/amendment supporting its checklist.
tasks.escalation: Use India Post complaint hierarchy/online complaint for service issues; succession-document disputes may require competent state/court handling.

state_local_dependency.description: Affidavit, disclaimer, indemnity, legal-heir certificates and court evidence are conditional; stamp/notarisation practice is not nationally specified here.

tasks.fail_closed_note: The general rule, scheme conditions and current operating guidance must be reconciled by the account office for the actual product.

tasks.title: Submit Central small-savings or postal death claim
tasks.user_goal: Obtain an acknowledged claim and account payment/closure or reasoned rejection.
tasks.trigger: The account office confirms the scheme and applicable claimant route.
steps: Use Form 11 and the current route-specific evidence confirmed by the account office.
For a no-nomination low-value route, use Forms 13/14/15 only when the six-month, value and rightful-claimant conditions are confirmed.
Retain submission acknowledgement and the payment/account-closure advice separately.
tasks.tracking: Transaction post-office acknowledgement and complaint number if raised.
tasks.rejection_handling: Request the exact current scheme/rule basis and cure only supported deficiencies.
tasks.escalation: Complain first at the transaction post office, then the next higher authority/online India Post route, and later Central grievance channels if applicable.

state_local_dependency.description: No-nomination higher-value or disputed claims can require state or court succession evidence.

tasks.fail_closed_note: No fee, interest, nationwide checklist or completion time is asserted.

tasks.title: Escalate India Post or MCA/IEPF service grievance
tasks.user_goal: Preserve a trackable Central-service grievance without using it to bypass succession proof.
tasks.trigger: A specific India Post or MCA/IEPF filing/service issue remains unresolved after the responsible office or company route.
steps: Use the responsible office/company grievance route first and retain the reference.
For India Post, follow the transaction-office and next-higher-authority sequence.
Use CPGRAMS for an eligible unresolved Central-service grievance and retain its registration ID.
tasks.tracking: India Post complaint number or CPGRAMS registration ID.
tasks.rejection_handling: Correct ministry/department/service categorisation; do not ask the grievance portal to determine inheritance.
tasks.escalation: Use appeal/reopen/review options shown by the portal for the specific grievance.

state_local_dependency.description: Central grievance systems do not replace state or judicial succession evidence.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Grievance closure is not claim-payment or transmission proof.

dependency_edges.condition: At least one institution or asset lead exists.
Bank deposit may exist or be unclaimed.
A UDGAM result identifies the bank; direct known accounts can bypass UDGAM.
Bank claimant category must be confirmed.
Bank complaint is rejected, unsatisfactory, or unanswered under the Ombudsman trigger.
A securities clue exists.
A demat account and DP are confirmed.
A physical folio, issuer and RTA are confirmed.
MITRA identifies an AMC/folio; a directly known folio can bypass MITRA.
Claimant category and absence/presence of dispute are confirmed.
Claimant category and dispute status are confirmed.
Claimant category and dispute status are confirmed.
DP/depository grievance remains unresolved.
AMC/RTA grievance remains unresolved.
Insurer and policy/service record are identified.
Prior insurer grievance is unresolved or unsatisfactory.
PF member record and claimant route are confirmed.
EPS family/nominee/dependent-parent and service conditions are confirmed.
Covered death-in-service and establishment status are confirmed.
Any EPFO death claim is delayed, rejected or unresolved.
Sector, CRA/nodal route and claimant evidence are confirmed; disputed government threshold is not auto-applied.
Nodal/CRA issue remains unresolved.
Company, original holder, folio/demat and asset details are confirmed.
Applicable SEBI transmission evidence and claimant category are confirmed.
Scheme, account office, holder mode, nomination, value and current rule are confirmed.
Claimant category and succession evidence route are confirmed.
India Post office/higher-authority route remains unresolved.
MCA/IEPF service issue remains unresolved after company/portal handling.
A competing claim or dispute exists; simplified SEBI transmission does not apply.
A court restraint or unresolved competing claim prevents the bank's ordinary nominee/survivor discharge route.

authorities_actors.name: Depository participant and depository

authorities_actors.name: Asset management company and qualified RTA

portal_journeys.name: UDGAM unclaimed-deposit search
portal_journeys.authentication: Registered user with name and mobile number; portal authentication controls apply.
portal_journeys.navigation: Register/login, select bank(s), enter account-holder name and an accepted search identifier or address, then open the result and bank claim link.
inputs_uploads: PAN, driving licence, voter ID, passport number or date of birth; address if none is available
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Search result and UDRN where returned.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: Retain UDRN and search date; actual claim tracking moves to the bank.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use the bank directly for known accounts or where UDGAM has no match.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Search only; participating-bank and DEA-Fund scope means no-match is not exhaustive.

portal_journeys.name: SBI deceased-claim digital example
portal_journeys.authentication: SBI's customer-care/deceased-claim process as described in its 2025 policy; live interaction requirements are bank controlled.
portal_journeys.navigation: Enter a deposit account, upload death/KYC documents, complete requested claim documents, select branch and retain CRM case ID.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: SBI CRM case ID and selected branch.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use branch or bank support; other banks require their own channel.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Regulated-actor example only; not a universal bank portal or checklist.

portal_journeys.name: RBI Complaint Management System
portal_journeys.authentication: Portal registration/contact details required by CMS.
portal_journeys.navigation: File complaint against regulated entity after the prior-complaint condition, upload records, and track complaint number.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use RBI's stated email/post routes if portal access is unavailable and maintainability conditions are met.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Service grievance only; does not decide inheritance or replace missing claim evidence.

portal_journeys.name: MITRA mutual-fund investment tracing
portal_journeys.authentication: Actual service authentication is controlled by the linked MFCentral/QRTA route and was not fixed in the circular.
portal_journeys.navigation: Open MITRA through MFCentral, AMC, AMFI, QRTA or SEBI link; search and identify AMC/folio.
inputs_uploads: Service-requested investor or rightful-claimant identity/search data
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Search result identifying a possible AMC/folio.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: Retain search reference; transmission tracking moves to AMC/RTA.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Covers inactive/unclaimed folios as defined by SEBI; not all mutual-fund records and not a claim portal.

portal_journeys.name: AMFI current transmission forms and matrix
portal_journeys.authentication: No authentication stated for form download; submission is to AMC/RTA.
portal_journeys.navigation: Select current transmission matrix/form for survivor, nominee or no-nomination band and submit to the AMC/RTA.
inputs_uploads: AMC/RTA-required supporting evidence under SEBI 2026 framework
portal_journeys.submission_proof: AMC/RTA acknowledgement, not the AMFI download.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Ask AMC/RTA for accessible current forms.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: AMFI hosts industry forms; it does not process or approve the claim.

portal_journeys.name: SEBI SCORES
portal_journeys.navigation: First complain to the entity, then register/file on SCORES, track and use review levels.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use the SEBI-listed alternative filing assistance if portal access is unavailable.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Grievance redress, not transmission submission or a succession adjudication.

portal_journeys.name: Bima Bharosa unclaimed-amount insurer directory
portal_journeys.authentication: Directory page itself is public; linked insurer searches may have separate controls.
portal_journeys.navigation: Select the relevant insurer and use its unclaimed-amount search/contact route.
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Insurer-specific search result or contact reference.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use policy/employer/bank records to identify and contact insurer.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Not a single cross-insurer claimant search and not a death-claim submission.

portal_journeys.name: LIC death-claim servicing-branch example
portal_journeys.authentication: No download authentication stated; claim is handled by LIC servicing branch.
portal_journeys.navigation: Notify servicing branch, obtain current claim form, submit death/policy/claimant evidence and product-specific additions.
inputs_uploads: Claim Form A or current applicable form
portal_journeys.exception_route: Contact LIC branch/support for unavailable policy or forms.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: LIC example only; other insurers and products can require different forms.

portal_journeys.name: Bima Bharosa insurance grievance
portal_journeys.navigation: First complain to insurer, then register grievance and track token/status.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use IRDAI's stated call/email channels; check Insurance Ombudsman eligibility separately.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Grievance route only; does not create policy entitlement.

portal_journeys.name: EPFO nominee death-claim portal path
portal_journeys.authentication: Portal-managed claimant/nominee authentication; exact supported cases must be checked live.
portal_journeys.navigation: Use the portal's death-claim filing path for nominee claims where available; otherwise use employer/EPFO office route.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Employer/EPFO office submission for unsupported online cases.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Portal labels nominee paths; do not assume all legal-heir, EPS or EDLI cases are online.

portal_journeys.name: EPFO claim status
portal_journeys.authentication: Office and PF/claim details as required by the linked service.
portal_journeys.navigation: Select office and enter PF account/claim data to check status.
portal_journeys.submission_proof: Displayed status; original claim acknowledgement remains primary submission proof.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Status does not prove payment until bank/PPO/benefit record exists.

portal_journeys.name: EPFiGMS
portal_journeys.authentication: Portal registration/contact and member/claim data required.
portal_journeys.navigation: Register grievance, select office/member/claim context, upload records and track registration number.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use EPFO contact-page escalation after the cited pending/unsatisfactory condition.

portal_journeys.name: PFRDA NPS exit/death-claim route
portal_journeys.authentication: Claim submission is through associated nodal office/POP and CRA controls.
portal_journeys.navigation: Identify CRA/nodal office, prepare death-withdrawal form, submit to nodal/POP for online initiation and authorisation.
inputs_uploads: Nomination or legal-heir evidence as applicable
portal_journeys.exception_route: Contact PFRDA/NPS Trust/CRA claim cell or nodal office.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Physical claimant request is not itself processed by CRA without nodal online initiation under the cited procedure.

portal_journeys.name: Protean CRA NPS death-withdrawal forms
portal_journeys.authentication: Public form access; claim processing requires nodal/CRA workflow.
portal_journeys.navigation: Download the current claimant death-withdrawal form matching the case and submit through the associated intermediary.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use the responsible CRA's current form where Protean is not the CRA.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Regulated-intermediary example; CRA must be identified for the PRAN.

portal_journeys.name: Pension Sahayak grievance portal
portal_journeys.authentication: Portal registration and PRAN/contact details required.
portal_journeys.navigation: Lodge grievance with intermediary/claim references and track status.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Grievance route; does not resolve the official threshold conflict automatically.

portal_journeys.name: MCA IEPF-5 claim
portal_journeys.navigation: MCA Services, Company e-Filing, IEPF Services, IEPF-5; submit, save SRN/acknowledgement/indemnity, notify company/bank and follow the kit's document/postal steps.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: MCA SRN plus company online-verification status.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use MCA help/service grievance and company IEPF nodal officer.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Login required; SRN is not final refund proof.

portal_journeys.name: India Post complaint route
portal_journeys.authentication: Online complaint registration may require contact details; office complaint can be acknowledged locally.
portal_journeys.navigation: Complain at transaction post office, obtain acknowledgement, escalate to next higher authority, and use online complaint route.
portal_journeys.tracking_route: India Post online status or higher-authority reference.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use the listed higher authority/DPG route after the prescribed sequence.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Service grievance; does not decide succession.

portal_journeys.name: CPGRAMS
portal_journeys.navigation: Select responsible Central ministry/department, submit grievance, save registration ID, track and use available appeal/review.
portal_journeys.exception_route: Use department-specific grievance routes first where required.
portal_journeys.access_limitation: Cannot adjudicate inheritance or substitute for a statutory claim.

required_inputs.name: Verifiable death certificate
required_inputs.when_required: All asset claims and many searches
required_inputs.format_validity: Institution must be able to verify the certificate; record mismatches require correction or clarification.

required_inputs.name: Asset lead records
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Banks, employers, intermediaries, companies or deceased person's records
required_inputs.format_validity: Statements, messages, tax records, certificates, passbooks and employer records are leads until institution-confirmed.

required_inputs.name: Claimant identity, address and tax/bank KYC
required_inputs.format_validity: Current, legible and matching the claimant; institution-specific KYC applies.

required_inputs.name: Institutional nomination, joint-holder, family or claimant-capacity evidence
required_inputs.format_validity: Must be confirmed against the particular account/policy/folio/member record; one asset's nomination does not apply to another.

required_inputs.name: Will, competing-claim and court-restraint facts
required_inputs.format_validity: Current case facts and authenticated court order where one exists.

required_inputs.name: Case-specific state or court succession evidence
required_inputs.when_required: Only for a route that expressly requires or accepts it
required_inputs.format_validity: Could include legal-heir certificate, will, probate, succession certificate, letters of administration or decree; validity and issuing forum are case specific.

required_inputs.name: UDGAM search data
required_inputs.format_validity: Account-holder name and bank plus accepted identifier/date/address as specified by RBI FAQ.

required_inputs.name: Bank account, deposit or UDRN evidence
required_inputs.format_validity: Known account/deposit details or UDGAM result identifying bank and UDRN.

required_inputs.name: Claimant bank-account proof for electronic payment
required_inputs.when_required: EPFO, NPS, IEPF and other payment routes
required_inputs.format_validity: Cancelled cheque/account evidence matching the claimant and live institution instructions.

required_inputs.name: DP, client ID, issuer, folio, RTA and value clues
required_inputs.format_validity: Institution-confirmed account/folio and value are required for transmission band.

required_inputs.name: Latest claimant client master list
required_inputs.when_required: SEBI transmission to demat account and IEPF share refund
required_inputs.format_validity: Latest verifiable CML as required by the receiving entity.

required_inputs.name: Original physical securities certificate or mutual-fund statement of account
required_inputs.when_required: Physical listed security or AMC SOA transmission
required_inputs.format_validity: Original/current instrument as required; loss exceptions are separate and not researched here.

required_inputs.name: SEBI no-nomination value-band documents
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Claimant, co-heirs, notary, state authority or court as applicable
required_inputs.when_required: No valid nomination under the 2026 SEBI framework
required_inputs.format_validity: QTP relationship/form-undertaking; simplified notarised indemnity plus NOCs or family settlement; or above-threshold accepted legal evidence, exactly as applicable.

required_inputs.name: MITRA claimant/investor search data
required_inputs.format_validity: Use only the fields required by the live QRTA service; no unsupported universal field list is asserted.

required_inputs.name: Insurer, policy, premium or group-cover record
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Insurer, employer, bank or policy papers
required_inputs.format_validity: Insurer-confirmed policy/service record; product terms must be checked separately.

required_inputs.name: UAN/PF account, employer, service, family and establishment facts
required_inputs.when_required: PF, EPS and EDLI classification and claim
required_inputs.format_validity: Institution-confirmed member/service data; death-in-service and exempted status must not be assumed.

required_inputs.name: PRAN, sector, CRA, nodal office/POP, nomination and corpus facts
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: CRA, NPS Trust, employer/nodal office or POP
required_inputs.format_validity: Current institution-confirmed record; government/non-government sector and current corpus value are essential.

required_inputs.name: Company, original holder, folio/demat, shares/dividends and IEPF details
required_inputs.format_validity: Company-confirmed investor-wise details matching IEPF-5.

required_inputs.name: Scheme, account office, passbook/certificate, holder mode and eligible balance
required_inputs.format_validity: Original/current account record and account-office confirmation.

required_inputs.name: Current postal death-claim forms
required_inputs.format_validity: Form 11 and, only when applicable, Forms 13/14/15 under current scheme/rule confirmation.

required_inputs.name: Prior complaint, acknowledgement, reply/rejection and dates
required_inputs.format_validity: Complete chronology with institution reference and supporting claim records.
