completion_proofs.validation_method: Each entry links to its source record and separates unknown/search/match/claim/settlement states.

completion_proofs.name: Institution-confirmed claimant route
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Dated record of institution confirmation plus supporting nomination/joint-holder/succession evidence.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match confirmation to the exact account, policy, folio, member record or PRAN.

completion_proofs.name: UDGAM search result or UDRN
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Portal result and Unclaimed Deposit Reference Number where returned.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match account-holder/bank and portal date; confirm result in bank claim channel.

completion_proofs.name: Bank deceased-claim acknowledgement
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Branch receipt, claim reference or CRM case ID.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match claimant, bank, account/UDRN and submission date.

completion_proofs.name: Bank payment or transmission proof
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Credit advice, account closure/transmission confirmation or reasoned final decision.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Reconcile institution reference, credited account and amount; do not infer beneficial distribution among heirs.

completion_proofs.name: DP/issuer/RTA locator response
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Institution response confirming demat/folio/issuer/RTA and holding mode.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match deceased identity and account/folio.

completion_proofs.name: SEBI transmission completeness acknowledgement
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Acknowledgement identifying received and missing/incomplete documents and later completeness confirmation.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match account/folio, entity, claimant and document-complete date.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Starts supported processing clock; not credit proof.

completion_proofs.name: Demat credit or transmission confirmation
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: DP statement/CAS or issuer/RTA transmission confirmation showing credit.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Reconcile ISIN, quantity, claimant demat and transaction date.

completion_proofs.name: MITRA search result
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Possible AMC/folio match.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Confirm the folio directly with AMC/RTA.

completion_proofs.name: Updated mutual-fund statement or CAS
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Statement/CAS showing transmitted units.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match folio, scheme, units, claimant and transaction date.

completion_proofs.name: Insurer policy/search confirmation
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Insurer reference confirming a possible policy or unclaimed amount.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match policyholder identity and insurer record; do not treat as benefit entitlement.

completion_proofs.name: Insurer death-claim acknowledgement
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Claim number and submission date.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match policy, deceased and claimant.

completion_proofs.name: Insurance settlement or reasoned decision
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Payment advice/bank credit or final reasoned decision.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Reconcile policy/claim reference and payment; policy terms remain controlling.

completion_proofs.name: EPFO member and scheme-route confirmation
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Record of UAN/PF, establishment, service/death and applicable Form 20/10D/5IF routes.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match member and employer; keep schemes distinct.

completion_proofs.name: EPFO claim acknowledgement
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Claim reference for Form 20, 10D or 5IF.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match member, claimant, form and office.

completion_proofs.name: EPF payment proof
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: EPFO payment advice and matching bank credit.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match claim reference and amount.

completion_proofs.name: EPS pension order and first credit
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: PPO/pension confirmation and bank credit.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match claimant, PPO and payment account.

completion_proofs.name: EDLI payment proof
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: EDLI payment advice and bank credit.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match Form 5IF claim and claimant.

completion_proofs.name: NPS sector and intermediary confirmation
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: PRAN-linked confirmation of sector, CRA/nodal office, nomination and applicable death-exit route.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match PRAN and cite current regulation; record any government-threshold response.

completion_proofs.name: NPS death-withdrawal acknowledgement
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: CRA/nodal claim reference.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match PRAN, claimant and submission date.

completion_proofs.name: NPS death-exit settlement proof
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Bank credit and, where selected/required, annuity or periodic-withdrawal contract.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Reconcile PRAN, amount, claimant and product/withdrawal record.

completion_proofs.name: Company-confirmed IEPF investor record
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Company/RTA confirmation of original holder, folio/demat, shares and amounts.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match company filing and claimant's record.

completion_proofs.name: IEPF-5 SRN and acknowledgement
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: MCA SRN, acknowledgement and generated indemnity.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match claimant, company and claimed shares/amounts.

completion_proofs.name: Company/bank online verification report status
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: MCA/company verification report/status.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match SRN and company nodal officer.

completion_proofs.name: IEPF shares or amount refund proof
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Demat credit and/or bank credit linked to SRN.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Reconcile ISIN/quantity/amount, claimant accounts and SRN.

completion_proofs.name: Account-office route confirmation
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Written/acknowledged confirmation of scheme, nomination, eligible balance, forms and legal-evidence route.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match account number, office and current rule/amendment.

completion_proofs.name: Postal death-claim acknowledgement
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Transaction-office receipt/reference.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match scheme/account, claimant and submitted forms.

completion_proofs.name: Postal small-savings payment or closure proof
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: Payment advice/bank credit or account closure/transmission record.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Reconcile account, eligible balance and claimant; do not infer heir distribution.

completion_proofs.name: Official grievance reference
completion_proofs.artifact_or_reference: RBI CMS, SCORES, Bima Bharosa, EPFiGMS, Pension Sahayak, India Post or CPGRAMS reference.
completion_proofs.validation_method: Match the responsible portal, institution, underlying claim and filing date.
completion_proofs.retention_use: Grievance tracking only; not claim settlement.

claims.statement: The verified official corpus provides asset-class-specific discovery routes but no single national search that proves the complete set of a deceased person's covered financial assets.
claims.subject: Cross-asset discovery
claims.applicability: This pack's covered asset classes and sources only; negative inference from route boundaries, not a claim that no private or future service exists.
claims.locator: Comparative scope of each official asset-class route; none states it is a complete cross-asset registry.

claims.statement: UDGAM lets registered users search unclaimed deposits transferred to the DEA Fund across participating banks.
claims.subject: Bank discovery
claims.applicability: UDGAM participating-bank/DEA-Fund records, not every bank asset.
claims.locator: UDGAM FAQ questions 1-3 and RBI launch release.

claims.statement: UDGAM search uses account-holder name, selected bank and one of PAN, driving licence, voter ID, passport number or date of birth, with address permitted where none is available.
claims.subject: UDGAM inputs
claims.applicability: Individual user search described in RBI FAQ.
claims.locator: UDGAM FAQ questions 5-6.

claims.statement: UDGAM does not receive or settle claims; the claimant must approach the respective bank, using the bank claim-process link and UDRN where available.
claims.subject: UDGAM boundary
claims.applicability: All UDGAM matches.
claims.locator: UDGAM FAQ questions 7-9.

claims.statement: Deposit balances unoperated or unclaimed for ten years are transferred by banks to the Depositor Education and Awareness Fund, while claims continue through the bank.
claims.subject: Unclaimed bank deposit lifecycle
claims.applicability: Covered bank deposit accounts under the DEA Fund Scheme.
claims.locator: DEA Fund FAQ questions 1, 3 and 5.

claims.statement: For a valid nominee or survivor claim, a bank may discharge itself after verifying death and claimant identity and absence of a restraining court order, while making clear that the recipient receives as trustee for legal heirs.
claims.subject: Bank nominee/survivor payment
claims.applicability: Accounts with valid nomination or survivorship mandate and no restraining court order.
claims.locator: Paragraph 20.1.1.

claims.statement: Banks should not insist on succession certificate, probate, letters of administration, indemnity or surety from a valid survivor/nominee regardless of account amount.
claims.subject: Bank nominee/survivor documents
claims.applicability: Valid survivor/nominee claims under the cited RBI instruction.
claims.locator: Paragraph 20.1.2.

claims.statement: Where there is no nominee or survivorship mandate, banks set their own simplified-procedure threshold based on risk; the RBI instruction does not create one national monetary threshold.
claims.subject: Bank no-nomination route
claims.applicability: No-nomination/no-survivorship deceased-depositor claims.
claims.locator: Paragraph 20.2.

claims.statement: Banks should settle valid survivor/nominee claims within 15 days from receipt, subject to proof of death and suitable claimant identification.
claims.subject: Bank nominee/survivor timeline
claims.applicability: Complete valid survivor/nominee claims under the cited RBI instruction.
claims.locator: RBI paragraph 20.6; SBI 2025 deceased-account claims section.

claims.statement: SBI's 2025 policy describes a deceased-claim digital intake with KYC/death uploads, selected branch and CRM case ID tracking.
claims.subject: Bank channel example
claims.applicability: SBI only; not generalized to other banks.
claims.locator: Deceased deposit accounts and Centralized Deceased Claim portal section, pages 43-44 in the PDF.

claims.statement: Under RBI's current Integrated Ombudsman framework, the complainant first approaches the regulated entity and may approach RBI after an unsatisfactory response or no response for 30 days, subject to the applicable maintainability/time rules; filing is free and trackable on CMS.
claims.subject: Bank grievance
claims.applicability: Complaints covered by the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme FAQ effective 1 July 2026.
claims.locator: FAQ sections on prior complaint, maintainability, filing, cost and tracking.

claims.statement: SEBI's 2026 transmission bands are: physical securities or AMC statement-of-account units per entity/AMC, QTP up to ₹10,000 and simplified up to ₹10 lakh; demat per beneficial-owner account, QTP up to ₹30,000 and simplified up to ₹30 lakh.
claims.subject: SEBI transmission value bands
claims.applicability: Listed securities and AMC units covered by the circular, effective 22 August 2026.
claims.locator: Circular pages 2 and 6, QTP and simplified thresholds/table.

claims.statement: For death of a joint holder, the surviving joint holder supplies only the death certificate without KYC, indemnity or undertaking, subject to nothing contrary in the company's articles.
claims.subject: SEBI surviving joint-holder route
claims.applicability: Covered joint holdings under the 2026 circular.
claims.locator: Circular joint-holder provision.

claims.statement: A registered nominee receives transmitted securities or units as trustee for the legal heirs and submits the specified transmission form, claimant CML, verifiable death certificate and certificate/SOA where applicable.
claims.subject: SEBI nominee route
claims.applicability: Covered nominee claims under the 2026 circular.
claims.locator: Circular nominee documentation and trustee provision.

claims.statement: Without nomination, SEBI's 2026 framework uses distinct QTP, simplified and above-threshold evidence routes, including defined immediate-relative proof for QTP, notarised indemnity/NOCs or family settlement for simplified cases, and specified will/state-legal-heir/court evidence combinations above threshold.
claims.subject: SEBI no-nomination transmission documents
claims.applicability: Undisputed covered claims without a valid nomination; actual band/value and state formalities must be confirmed.
claims.locator: Circular no-nomination QTP, simplified and above-threshold provisions and annexed forms.

claims.statement: Covered intermediaries must process transmission within 21 calendar days after receiving all required documents.
claims.subject: SEBI transmission timeline
claims.applicability: Complete, covered, undisputed transmission requests under the 2026 circular.
claims.locator: Circular processing timeline provision.

claims.statement: The receiving entity must acknowledge receipt and identify missing/incomplete documents; delay or rejection reasons must be communicated in writing, and additional documents beyond the framework require written reasons.
claims.subject: SEBI acknowledgement and rejection
claims.applicability: Covered transmission requests under the 2026 circular.
claims.locator: Circular acknowledgement, additional-document and rejection provisions.

claims.statement: The SEBI simplified transmission framework does not apply to disputed or competing claims, which proceed through appropriate legal/judicial handling.
claims.subject: SEBI dispute boundary
claims.applicability: Competing/disputed claims.
claims.locator: Circular scope/exclusion for disputed claims.

claims.statement: MITRA is an industry searchable database operated by CAMS and KFin QRTAs to help investors or rightful legal claimants trace inactive or unclaimed mutual-fund folios.
claims.subject: Mutual-fund discovery
claims.applicability: Inactive/unclaimed mutual-fund folios in the SEBI circular's scope.
claims.locator: Circular paragraphs 1-5.

claims.statement: MITRA defines an inactive folio as one with no investor-initiated financial or non-financial transaction for ten years while a unit balance remains; a search result still requires AMC/RTA transmission.
claims.subject: MITRA scope boundary
claims.applicability: MITRA records and resulting AMC/RTA process.
claims.locator: Circular definition and platform purpose, paragraphs 2-5.

claims.statement: AMFI hosts an August 2026 transmission-document matrix and forms reflecting the current SEBI framework for death of a unit holder.
claims.subject: Mutual-fund forms
claims.applicability: Form selection support; actual claim is processed by AMC/RTA.
claims.locator: Death of Unit Holder page, August 2026 matrix/forms.

claims.statement: SCORES requires the investor first to take the grievance to the entity and then supports registration, tracking and two review levels.
claims.subject: Securities grievance
claims.applicability: SEBI-regulated entity service grievances.
claims.locator: SCORES home and FAQ workflow.

claims.statement: No current primary source in this research establishes a public cross-DP/cross-issuer deceased-claimant search for all listed securities.
claims.subject: Securities discovery gap
claims.applicability: Unknown DP/issuer/folio cases; not a claim that no future/private search exists.
claims.locator: The transmission circular governs known records and does not provide a universal discovery service.

claims.statement: IRDAI's Bima Bharosa unclaimed-amount page lists insurer-specific routes rather than receiving a single cross-insurer death claim.
claims.subject: Insurance discovery
claims.applicability: Unclaimed-amount discovery leads.
claims.locator: Unclaimed Amount page insurer list/links.

claims.statement: LIC's current first-party route directs the legally entitled person to the servicing branch and lists Claim Form A, death evidence, original policy/assignment records and possible case/product additions.
claims.subject: Insurance death-claim example
claims.applicability: LIC example only; not a universal insurer checklist or entitlement rule.
claims.locator: Download Forms, Death Claims section; page updated 27 April 2026.

claims.statement: The Bima Bharosa FAQ instructs policyholders to complain to the insurer first and allows IRDAI escalation if the insurer does not resolve the grievance within 15 days, with token-based tracking.
claims.subject: Insurance grievance
claims.applicability: Insurance service grievances in Bima Bharosa scope.
claims.locator: FAQ questions on when/how to complain and tracking.

claims.statement: EPFO identifies Form 20 for claiming provident-fund dues after a member's death by the applicable nominee, beneficiary or legal heir.
claims.subject: EPF death claim
claims.applicability: Deceased EPF member claim, subject to claimant/member record.
claims.locator: Which Claim Form, death cases; Form 20 instructions.

claims.statement: EPFO identifies Form 10D for an applicable family-pension claim after member death, with claimant category depending on family/nomination/dependent-parent facts.
claims.subject: EPS death pension
claims.applicability: Only where pension claimant and service conditions are met.
claims.locator: Which Claim Form, death cases; Form 20 instructions discussion of Form 10D claimant categories.

claims.statement: EPFO identifies Form 5IF for an EDLI benefit claim where the member died while in service, subject to the applicable establishment/coverage route.
claims.subject: EDLI death claim
claims.applicability: Covered death while in service; not every EPF member death.
claims.locator: Which Claim Form, death cases; Form 20 instructions note on Form 5IF.

claims.statement: EPFO provides EPFiGMS for grievances and asks a claimant to write with the grievance reference if it remains pending for more than 15 days or redressal is unsatisfactory.
claims.subject: EPFO grievance
claims.applicability: EPFiGMS grievances under the cited EPFO contact instruction.
claims.locator: Contact page grievance section.

claims.statement: For a non-government NPS subscriber who dies before exit, the current regulation provides the entire accumulated wealth to nominee/legal heirs as lump sum, with optional periodic withdrawal or annuity; if no nomination exists, it accepts a state competent-authority legal-heir certificate or court succession certificate.
claims.subject: Non-government NPS death exit
claims.applicability: Non-government sector death before exit under regulation 4(1)(c), current through 20 July 2026.
claims.locator: Regulation 4(1)(c), PDF page 10.

claims.statement: The current consolidated NPS regulation states a government-sector death-exit full-withdrawal option at accumulated wealth up to ₹8 lakh and a separate ₹8-12 lakh route, while a current official FAQ still states ₹5 lakh.
claims.subject: Government NPS death-exit threshold
claims.applicability: Government-sector death before superannuation; do not automate while conflict is unresolved for operations.
claims.locator: Regulation 3(1)(c), PDF pages 6-7; government-sector FAQ death-withdrawal answer.

claims.statement: PFRDA's live government-sector FAQ states a ₹5 lakh full-withdrawal threshold on death, which is inconsistent with the consolidated regulation amended 20 July 2026.
claims.subject: Government NPS FAQ threshold
claims.applicability: FAQ should not control the case without PFRDA/CRA clarification.
claims.locator: Government-sector FAQ death question; compare regulation 3(1)(c).

claims.statement: The claimant submits the NPS death-withdrawal request to the associated nodal office/POP, which initiates and authorises the online CRA claim based on claimant documents.
claims.subject: NPS death-claim process
claims.applicability: NPS death withdrawals through the applicable intermediary.
claims.locator: Exit NPS procedure and death-claim workflow.

claims.statement: Protean CRA publishes a claimant withdrawal form for death cases among its current NPS forms.
claims.subject: NPS intermediary form
claims.applicability: Only where Protean is the responsible CRA and the live form matches the case.
claims.locator: Forms page, withdrawal by claimant due to death.

claims.statement: PFRDA provides Pension Sahayak as a portal to lodge and track pension/NPS grievances.
claims.subject: NPS grievance
claims.applicability: Service grievances in portal scope.
claims.locator: PFRDA portal grievance/Pension Sahayak link.

claims.statement: The IEPF-5 kit directs an applicant to file through MCA IEPF services, save the SRN and generated acknowledgement/indemnity, notify the company/bank and follow the stated supporting-document/postal steps.
claims.subject: IEPF refund process
claims.applicability: IEPF-5 claims including claimant/successor cases supported by the form.
claims.locator: IEPF-5 instruction kit, submission and post-submission steps/field instructions.

claims.statement: The IEPF e-verification kit requires the company or bank to submit its online verification report within 30 days of receiving the claim.
claims.subject: IEPF company verification
claims.applicability: IEPF claims requiring company/bank verification.
claims.locator: Online verification instruction kit, verification timeline.

claims.statement: SEBI's 2026 circular states that the same securities-transmission approach applies to securities transferred to IEPF.
claims.subject: IEPF transmission evidence
claims.applicability: IEPF-held listed securities in the circular's scope.
claims.locator: Circular IEPF applicability provision.

claims.statement: No live current primary source in this research established a reliably navigable cross-company deceased-claimant search for all IEPF-held shares and amounts.
claims.subject: IEPF discovery gap
claims.applicability: Unknown company/folio cases; company records and disclosures remain leads.
claims.locator: IEPF-5 requires company/holder/folio details and is a claim form, not a universal discovery service.

claims.statement: Government Savings Promotion General Rule 15 provides a nominee route using Form 11 and proof of death for the eligible balance after death of the sole or all joint holders.
claims.subject: Central small-savings nominee route
claims.applicability: Accounts governed by General Rule 15 and relevant scheme conditions.

claims.statement: Without nomination and where probate, letters of administration or succession certificate has not been produced within six months, General Rule 15 allows the account office to pay an eligible balance not exceeding ₹5 lakh to a person appearing entitled using Form 11, death proof, passbook/statement and Forms 13, 14 and 15.
claims.subject: Central small-savings simplified no-nomination route
claims.applicability: Rule 15 conditions and scheme/account-office confirmation; no dispute or automatic entitlement is inferred.
claims.locator: General Rule 15(3); SBI SCSS FAQ deceased claim below ₹5 lakh.

claims.statement: The currently hosted General Rule 15 text states that a no-nomination eligible balance above ₹5 lakh requires a succession certificate with claim form, passbook/statement and death certificate.
claims.subject: Central small-savings above-₹5-lakh route
claims.applicability: General-rule text; current scheme/account-office implementation must be confirmed because official operating guidance lists broader legal evidence.
claims.locator: General Rule 15(4); compare SBI SCSS FAQ deceased claim above ₹5 lakh.

claims.statement: SBI's current SCSS FAQ lists probate, letters of administration, succession certificate or a Tehsildar-issued legal-heir certificate for a no-nomination claim above ₹5 lakh, broader than the currently hosted General Rule 15 text.
claims.subject: SCSS above-₹5-lakh operating guidance
claims.applicability: SBI SCSS only until reconciled with current law and other account offices.
claims.locator: SBI SCSS FAQ deceased claim above ₹5 lakh; compare General Rule 15(4).

claims.statement: India Post instructs customers to complain at the transaction post office and obtain acknowledgement, then approach the next higher authority and use the online complaint route.
claims.subject: India Post grievance
claims.applicability: India Post service grievances.
claims.locator: Grievance-redress guidelines and escalation sequence.

claims.statement: CPGRAMS provides registration-ID-based filing and tracking for eligible Central-government service grievances.
claims.subject: Central grievance
claims.applicability: Eligible Central department service grievances after the responsible route; not succession adjudication.
claims.locator: Portal registration, lodge grievance, status and appeal functions.

claims.statement: The cited official regimes accept different succession evidence depending on asset, value, nomination, dispute and sector, so no single national legal-heir/probate/succession/notarisation checklist is supported.
claims.subject: Cross-asset succession dependency
claims.applicability: Only the covered regimes; state and court competence remain case specific.
claims.locator: RBI paragraphs 20.1-20.2; SEBI no-nomination bands; NPS regulations 3-4; General Rule 15; IEPF-5 conditional claimant fields.

conflicts.description: The consolidated NPS regulation amended 20 July 2026 says ₹8 lakh for the government-sector death full-withdrawal option, while PFRDA's live FAQ says ₹5 lakh.
conflicts.safe_treatment: Treat the regulation as higher-tier evidence but do not auto-calculate or promise a government-sector outcome; obtain written/current CRA/nodal confirmation.
conflicts.resolution_owner_action: PFRDA should update or explain the FAQ; claimant should ask the associated nodal office/CRA to cite the current rule applied to the PRAN.

conflicts.description: The hosted General Rule 15 text lists a succession certificate for no-nomination balances above ₹5 lakh, while current SBI SCSS guidance lists probate, letters of administration, succession certificate or a Tehsildar legal-heir certificate.
conflicts.safe_treatment: Do not generate a universal above-₹5-lakh checklist. Obtain the scheme/account office's current written rule/amendment and competent-document route.
conflicts.resolution_owner_action: DEA/India Post or the operating account office should identify the current consolidated scheme rule; claimant should preserve that response.

demo_scenario.title: Bounded multi-asset example: Anita inventories Raj's possible assets
demo_scenario.purpose: Demonstrate discovery-first routing across multiple asset classes without treating nomination, a search match or a submission acknowledgement as settlement.
assumptions: Fictional people: Raj is deceased and Anita is his spouse; no real person or account is represented.
A verifiable death certificate exists and matches the known institution records.
No competing claim or court restraint is presently known, but this must be rechecked with each institution.
SBI confirms Anita is the registered nominee on one deposit; a UDGAM search is also run for other DEA-Fund deposits.
A DP confirms Anita is the surviving joint holder of one demat account.
MITRA returns a possible inactive mutual-fund folio with no recorded nomination; AMC value and relationship band remain unconfirmed.
LIC confirms a policy and recorded nomination; product terms and benefit remain unconfirmed.
Raj's UAN and employer are known and death occurred while in service, but EPS family/service and EDLI coverage facts still require EPFO/employer confirmation.
A non-government NPS PRAN and recorded nomination are confirmed; the government-sector threshold conflict is therefore not used in this example.
A company/folio lead suggests IEPF-held shares, but company/RTA transmission acceptance is not yet complete.
An NSC account lead shows no nomination and an assumed eligible balance of ₹4 lakh; the account office has not yet confirmed the current scheme/form route.

qualifier_answers.answer: Yes; assumption for the demo, with institution record matching still checked.
Different by asset: bank/LIC/NPS nominee, demat survivor, possible legal heir for MF/IEPF/postal.
No known dispute/restraint; action required to reconfirm.
Bank, demat, MF, insurance, EPFO, NPS, IEPF and postal leads.
One known SBI deposit plus a UDGAM search for possible unclaimed deposits.
Joint demat, MF SOA, and possible IEPF-held shares.
Unknown for MF and IEPF; DP confirms only the joint-account route.
UAN/employer and death-in-service assumed known; scheme conditions unconfirmed.
Non-government PRAN/CRA/nodal route and nomination confirmed.
Company/folio lead known; RTA transmission evidence pending.
NSC, no nomination, assumed ₹4 lakh; account-office confirmation pending.

out_of_scope_facts: Whether Anita is the beneficial owner under personal law or must distribute to other heirs
Validity of a will, heirship, state stamp/notarisation practice or court jurisdiction
